$comment: MCP tool contract for `research`. MCP-side only (no model hop for this shape - 003 D6 precedent). key_findings/disagreements/sources/stats are server-assembled; the model writes the answer prose, the gaps, and the sub-question each gap concerns (021 gap_targets). Every published number is computed by the server from that input - the model never emits a confidence, coverage, or rate directly. Every key finding cites at least one source; every cited id resolves in sources; the grounding gate enforces this before return.
name: research
description: Offload a research question; get back a short, cited, adversarially-verified answer - not a pile of links. Runs scoped parallel searches, fetches and extracts sources, verifies every claim with independent refute-biased passes, and synthesizes a compact answer with inline citations, surfaced disagreements, and honest gaps. Depth scales rigor; budget and deadline ceilings synthesize early and say so. Every citation resolves to a source fetched during the run.

question.description: The research question, in natural language.

depth.description: Rigor tier; scales angles, sources, and verification votes. Default standard.

focus.description: Optional angles to bias the search toward.

max_sources.description: Hard cap on fetched sources; overrides the tier default.

domains_allow.description: Restrict fetching to these registrable domains.

budget_tokens.description: Hard token ceiling; hitting it synthesizes early with stopped_early set.

deadline_ms.description: Hard wall-clock ceiling; hitting it synthesizes early with stopped_early set.

confidence.description: Support established for the claims the answer asserts - the mean confidence of the published findings. NOT reduced by unsettled sub-questions; breadth is reported separately. Zero only when no claim was supported. (021)

refutation_rate.description: Proportion of verified claims that verification refuted. Reported beside confidence rather than folded into it, so a run whose evidence largely fell apart is distinguishable from one whose evidence held. 0 when no claim was verified. (021)

coverage.description: Proportion of the run's scoped sub-questions that were settled - breadth of resolution, which confidence used to be multiplied by and no longer is. Equals the fraction of sub_question_status marked settled, or 1 when the run scoped no sub-questions (the list is then empty and nothing is unsettled). (021)

sub_question_status.description: Each sub-question the run scoped and whether it was settled. The published basis for coverage, so the figure is checkable from this output rather than taken on trust. (021)

gaps.description: What could not be answered, plus anything demoted by the grounding gate.
